Description

At BrightView, the best teams are created and maintained here. If you are searching for your next fulfilling career, picture yourself on a best-in-class team where you can grow to be your brightest. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst. Can you picture yourself here?

Here’s what you’d do:

The Senior Data Analyst leads high-impact analytics initiatives and helps shape data-driven decision making across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders to define business needs, build scalable analytical solutions, and mentor junior analysts while championing best practices in data and reporting.

You’d be responsible for

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, including requirement gathering, scoping, data preparation, visualization, maintenance, and ongoing enhancement of dashboards and reports.
Manage data from multiple sources, including Salesforce, Azure Service Fabric, JDE, and Workday, to create integrated views and ensure data integrity and consistency.
Serve as a bridge between business teams and technical teams, ensuring analytics solutions are actionable and aligned to organizational priorities.
Identify opportunities for automation, efficiency, and process improvements across reporting and analytics workflows.
Identify new or underserved areas of the business and develop analytical solutions to close the gaps.
Promote adoption of dashboards and reporting solutions by developing documentation, delivering training, and demonstrating the value of analytics.
Contribute to data strategy by championing data quality, governance, and scalable practices.
Mentor junior analysts on tools, methods, best practices, and business communication.

You might be a good fit if you have:

Bachelor’s degree in a business, technical, or related field
5+ years of relevant experience, including 1–2 years in a senior or lead capacity.
Advanced skills in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization design)
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Alteryx, and Microsoft Excel
Experience with Fabric, Azure Service Fabric, and OneLake is preferred.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tell compelling stories with data and provide actionable recommendations.
Experience working with enterprise data platforms (e.g., Azure, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks) and integrating multiple systems.
Solid understanding of data management, governance, quality, and information security practices
Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, foster strong partnerships, and drive change with urgency.
Exceptional attention to detail and appreciation for the relationships among process, data, and business outcomes
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Here’s what to know about working here:

Here at BrightView, we’re as passionate about caring for our clients as we are about caring for each other. Though we’re the nation’s leading landscape company, we maintain a small company feel and supportive environment that makes our team members feel at home.

If you’re looking to join a team of talented go-getters who tackle big vision projects other companies could only dream of, you just might have found your match. With our range of services, including landscape design, development, maintenance and enhancements, there’s no limit to what we can do, and what you can achieve.

Growing Everyday

Like the communities we serve, you are on a constant path of discovery to shape your career and personal development. In addition to best-in-class opportunities and competitive salary, you may be eligible for benefits and perks like:

Paid time off
Health and wellness coverage
401k savings plan

Division Information


Spectrum Brands’ global enabling functions, including Finance, Legal, IT, Human Resources, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations, provide enterprise-wide strategy, structure, and common processes to deliver the knowledge and expertise that helps our businesses grow. Enabling functions may operate as a center-led global team, providing a central strategy, structure, and standards; or as business partner teams, with resources embedded within the businesses to deliver business unit-specific results.


Job Summary


The Global MDM (Master Data Management) Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting our implementation of SAP S4/HANA and other MDM transformation efforts to develop globally harmonized data standards and improve business processes to ensure we maintain ‘one data source of truth’ and robust data governance. While ownership lives within the respective business functions, this position will support efforts to sustain data governance on an ongoing basis.


Primary Duties & Responsibilities


The Global MDM Data Analyst is responsible for supporting, monitoring, and analyzing master data within the organization. Responsible for developing reporting solutions to help improve decisions for the organization, design and produce user-friendly intelligence reporting, business metrics, reports, dashboards, and data solutions.

Support implementation of S4/HANA and MDG by validating multiple variations of Pre-load and Post-load reports; including Material Master Data, Classification Data, and List of Value (LOV) tables.
Support MDM Team in building out best practice approach to manage reporting and analytics.
Ensure data integrity by performing routine monthly audits to check for completeness, conformity, and consistency.
Develop and document processes with support of Domain Leaders to create business processes.
Assist in the creation of Data Cleansing files for the business owners.
Update Cleansing Tracker weekly to ensure forward progress in Cleansing initiatives.
Administer MDM dashboards and data visualization within the PowerBI tool.
Collaborate with MDM Leads to maintain content within MDM SharePoint Library.


Education and Experience Profile


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Data Science, or relevant disciplines required
3 or more years of experience in Master Data Management or equivalent required
2 or more years of experience with Visual Analytics tools (Power BI) preferred
2 or more years of experience in supporting SAP Implementation strongly preferred
Role not eligible for sponsorship

Required Skills

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
Effective project planning and resource coordination experience
Excellent documentation skills required
Must be comfortable interacting with management of all levels
Able to participate in project work as both a SME and performer
Microsoft Office expertise, especially with Excel and Pivot Tables
Strong multi-tasking and time management skills
Ability to develop & maintain strong relationships with cross-functional groups
Experience working with data sets from multiple sources
Extreme attention to detail
English proficiency
Ability to operate in a changing environment and respond positively to change


Work Environment


Working conditions are normal for an office environment.
